Writing Tidy Go Programs

This page explains how to organize a small Go program. Read the modules guide first.

Packages #

Every Go file starts with a package clause.

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
  • Keep package names short.
  • Avoid repeating the package name in exported names.
